dcterms:description: The EPIC-KITCHENS-100 dataset comprises 100 hours of recordings of actions in a kitchen environment, with annotations that include verbs and entities related to the actions performed.
dcterms:title: EPIC-KITCHENS-100

dcterms:description: A modified version of the EPIC-KITCHENS-100 dataset used for evaluating error correction approaches in request dialogs, focusing on annotations with one or two entities.
dcterms:title: Modified EPIC-KITCHENS-100 for Error Correction
